ModMetaData.name: Ariandel Example: Named Character (Vesper)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Example mod for Ariandel Library's Special Character Framework (SCMF).
Adds one named, unique, non-random character: Vesper, the Ash Singer — a vanilla-human hero with a fixed name, backstory, traits, a passive hediff and one active ability. She joins the colony through the Shroud break-in ritual (build the "Shroud break in ritual spot" from Ariandel Library and perform the ritual), gets auto-registered into the Special Character Manager, and cannot truly die (death sends her back to the Shroud for a resurrection cooldown).
100% XML, no C#. Written as a study template: every file mirrors the official "Sample: Special Character Framework" (Workshop 3668177055) but on a vanilla human, so no race mod is required.
本 mod 是 Ariandel Library 特殊角色框架的範例：新增一名具名獨特角色「燼歌者・薇絲珀」，固定姓名／背景／特質，帶被動 hediff 與一個主動技能，經虛境突入儀式入場並自動登錄特殊角色管理器，不會真死。全程純 XML。
